title: modelscope agent-zero 1.7, 1.8, 1.9, and 1.10 is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in… (CVE-2026-51851)
description: modelscope agent-zero versions 1.7, 1.8, 1.9, and 1.10 contain a directory traversal vulnerability in the save_text_file method of python/helpers/file_browser.py. This method improperly handles user-supplied file paths without normalization or validation, allowing attackers to write files outside the intended directory.
